During the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] preparations to [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|attack]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TotJ" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="date">The [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] is dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> he gathered [[Sith invasion fleet|his military forces]] from all across the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], including from a '''planet''' that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|sun]] and had at least two [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The world had rust-colored [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on its surface. A stone [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] had been built near those mountains, and during Sadow's military buildup, a large number of [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] caste embarked on waiting [[Sith dreadnaught|Sith personnel carriers]] in the vicinity of the structure. The amassed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ground forces also included several bipedal war beasts with artillery emplacements on their backs.<ref name="TotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
To date, the planet has only appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|second]] issue of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire|''The Fall of the Sith Empire'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published in [[1997]] and was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]]<ref name="TotJ" />
